text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report recommends that Scarborough Community Council not authorize the installation of all-way stop control at the intersection of Deep Dene Drive and Camor Court as the existing conditions do not meet the warrant for the installation of such a traffic control device. Currently, this intersection has a stop control facing the eastbound approach on Camor Court at Deep Dene Drive.
Scarborough Community Council: 1. Authorized all-way compulsory stop control at the intersection of Deep Dene Drive and Camor Court.
